meta: Summarize meetings with AI from a recording or notes: after an hour-long meeting nobody remembers who's doing what, so let AI write tidy minutes.

muc.title: The meeting ends, the tasks are forgotten
muc.text: After an hour-long meeting nobody remembers who's doing what. AI can turn a recording or your notes into tidy minutes.

muc.title: Ask everyone before recording
muc.text: Ask everyone's permission before recording, and don't record meetings with confidential topics.

muc.title: Decisions, owners, deadlines
muc.text: Ask AI to summarize in three parts: decisions made, who does what, and the deadline for each task.

muc.title: Check names and dates
muc.text: Double-check names and dates, because AI often mishears names, then send it to the team to confirm.

muc.title: Your last meeting notes
muc.text: Take the notes from your last meeting, remove anything sensitive, and ask AI to split them into decisions, owners and deadlines.

thu: Take the notes from your last meeting, remove anything sensitive, and ask AI to split them into decisions, owners and deadlines.
